title: Compact library cards
goals: Every recipe said in one line
Every move, layer and expression in a few words
The card: pills, short labels, figures that do not collide
A check that fails on a long line
Seen with the stage behind it, on a real GPU

clips.name: The meadow, one tent
clips.why: the game as it starts: the one tent on the meadow. The library, where every thing of the city is looked at, is a page of its own and not in this shot

clips.name: Towards the tent
clips.why: nearer the tent: one thing, seen plainly, which is what a card is for

captions.text: Make the prose of each variant way more compact.
The Body took 560 letters to say what it is.
Now 64. Fifty-four things, one line each.
A move was a box of six lines. Now it is a pill.
The Body's card: 2768 px tall before, 647 now.
